verdict.rationale: EBANX documents low-effort ways to accept payments: a no-code payment link created in the dashboard, a hosted checkout page, and an embeddable UI component, plus sandbox test cards for card payments. Together these suggest a fast technical path to card acceptance. Nothing in the evidence addresses signup, merchant onboarding or approval timelines, or self-serve activation of live processing, so the 'within a day of signing up' core of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documented self-serve signup and account activation, stated time-to-live or onboarding/KYC turnaround, evidence that live card payments can go through on day one, and independent or hands-on corroboration of onboarding speed.
